The '''Gendius system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Gendius sector/Legends|Gendius sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Gendius V]] occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position within the system.<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gendius system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square J-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
